## Design

### 2026-10-06 – October 6:

**2h**

October 6:
Started designing a pcb for my starbie

I began by watching some tutorials for using KiCad, then attempted to recreate the design from the guide to have a base that I can now build on.
The most challenging part was trying to add components. Because of my little experience I ended up having to delete and reopen the components almost 5 times each, which made it a very tedious and time consuming process.

![IMG_7372](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/53e2ee85cf0f0620621cc0aacc662b73cecad2d1a47a726bab8eaed3ca31780c.jpeg)

In the end I managed to complete my base design and decided to stop there for today. I’m doubtful about having done this properly so I will be asking people to check my work and I will make revisions next session.

![IMG_7371](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/2864232d46c5e3dc1bd9ae3aba65096c72a2a8afe172b9605961531fbe628ac5.jpeg)

Time spent: 2 hours

**2.7h**

October 7:
I wanted to reach the 3 hour mark today but I only got to 2 hours and 45 minutes before ending today’s session.

### 2026-10-08 – October 8: Can’t solve the errors

**2h**

October 8: Can’t solve the errors

Yesterday I had asked around about how to get the wiring to overlap, and I found out that I could add blue ones on the other layer which was very helpful. After I figured that out I erased the red ones from yesterday and started over with a clean slate.
First I fixed how the components were placed, since the buttons were overlapping and I was told that would be problematic during assembly.
Then I started on connecting everything again and it only took 4 tries until everything looked right.

![IMG_7393](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/10fae9a58c5f440a3bd371e5d27025a417138b23785013e2023dc004c8cf975d.jpg)

![IMG_7396](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/fc11d4496f7b2109ad1d6d5be07b2f11a2319ff4fb0772ade6a730b4b0990c79.jpg)

After this I was sure the hard part was done and I only needed to download the Arduino app so I downloaded everything and added all the libraries named in the guide.

But when I ran the DRC, an error appeared.

![IMG_7395](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/971992e358c06255ea95d9e78018160b6369938599cafe198388c44de873a03f.jpg)

![IMG_7394](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/40ccf6653c96e9a07429d968d6eee19d1cc955abb4d50963247716a9d98e6821.jpg)

Ive spent quite some time trying to resolve this issue but nothing I tried worked.
I tried
.deleting the lines and replacing them using cut and paste
.deleting the lines and redrawing them
.changing the angles to 45 degrees
.changing the angles to 90 degrees
But none of these things would solve the error pointing at the corner. And so Ive asked for help in the help channel.
Session duration: 2 hours

### 2026-10-09 – October 9: mostly finished with week one

**4h**

October 9: mostly finished with week one

Today I began by trying to solve yesterday’s error. Because I still had no idea why the error kept persisting, I ended up deleting and redrawing the outline multiple times.

![IMG_7394](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/40ccf6653c96e9a07429d968d6eee19d1cc955abb4d50963247716a9d98e6821.jpg)
Eventually I realized that the line tool I had chosen was causing the problem. So to turn the entire thing into a single polygon I used the ‘draw polygon’ tool.
It worked! I ran the analysis and it returned no errors (except the ones the guide said were expected). Still, I didn't like how uneven the shape was when I tried drawing it all as one continuous line, so I redrew the shape I wanted with the line tool and then I traced it with the polygon tool.

![IMG_7401](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/f28670c27297276356ba887e358986e27c27e869926e8003726d7772db6e0fa5.jpg)

![IMG_7406](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/747394b5da530c6d4da185115dc1e9ac13d313cb41ef50ab108a27620c3db71c.jpg)
Next, I tried adding a GND pour like the guide showed, but, no matter how I drew it, the pour wouldn't work and clicking ‘B’ wouldn't fill it.
So I decided to skip that.
After this I started with the coding. I had already downloaded everything yesterday so I began working on the code. The first change I made was renaming the actions and placing ‘bat’ in the beginning of all of them. For example ‘feed’ became ‘batbrunch’ and so on. Then I added the sparkle trail’s code and began working on designing my sprite. I tried a few different designs for my sprite before finally drawing one that I think is perfect.

![IMG_7402](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/330bd7a45eebb2234269c5caf8394cf3a25edbfd6a55d77759daef38a20391fc.jpg)

Finally I used the linked website to convert the image and added it to my code.

![IMG_7403](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/9d6d014ad37e16f6ea0c91379cf43231b73cc86fa4b23640308ef53bc1ea0c66.jpg)

As of now, I think my project is ready to submit, but Im going to use tomorrow to personalize it a little more and then start working on my repository, which I have no idea how to do.

Time spent: 4 hours
